name: Auto Layout Maker
description: Build a short spawn-relative platform from selected solid-block frequencies, with a clear approach and no hazards.

rating-title.name: Pattern Profile
rating-title.description: Choose the generated route length. This does not assign stars or change gameplay difficulty.

rating.name: Layout Rating
rating.description: Auto estimates route length from the selected layout. V2 leaves an open run-up, then builds short one-block-high platform sections over continuous ground; no hazards, portals, orbs, triggers, or ground gaps are generated.

filter-title.name: Exclude From Analysis
filter-title.description: These filters affect scan totals and Auto route-length analysis. V2 only uses ordinary 30 x 30 solid blocks.

exclude-gamemodes.name: Exclude Gamemode Portals
exclude-gamemodes.description: Exclude portals from scan and Auto analysis. V2 omits portals in every profile.

exclude-blocks.name: Exclude Blocks and Slopes
exclude-blocks.description: Ordinary 30 x 30 solid blocks are the frequency samples used to build V2. Excluding them prevents V2 generation.

exclude-hazards.name: Exclude Hazards
exclude-hazards.description: Exclude hazards from scan and Auto analysis. V2 omits hazards in every profile.

exclude-pickups.name: Exclude Orbs, Pads, and Collectibles
exclude-pickups.description: Exclude orbs, pads, and collectibles from scan and Auto analysis. V2 omits them in every profile.

exclude-triggers.name: Exclude Triggers
exclude-triggers.description: Exclude triggers from scan and Auto analysis. V2 omits triggers in every profile.

exclude-decoration.name: Exclude Decoration
exclude-decoration.description: Exclude decoration from scan and Auto analysis.

exclude-other.name: Exclude Other Objects
exclude-other.description: Exclude miscellaneous objects from scan and Auto analysis. V2 does not generate them.
